title: Marguerite and the Compass
author: Vesper Hartwell
blurb: Theo Ashgrove, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
